reference_stereo._comment: Upstream config/realsense_d435/d435_multi.yaml: depth limits for its 50 mm baseline. They are scaled to the standard baseline by tools/calibration.py.

imu_noise._comment: Upstream d435_multi.yaml defaults, not tuned to the simulation. The standard 3-axis gyro has a 1% scale error per axis (D2VINS does not model it) and no accelerometer error model.

motion_policy: stereo clearance with periodic scans; own explorer, not replay (same driver as Door Slam)
